_about: Expected MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs per log file in data/logs/. Used by evaluate.py for precision/recall/F1. Source logs: Cyber-Agent mordor_dataset (OTRF Security-Datasets, Atomic Red Team simulations).

bitsadmin_download.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs 'bitsadmin.exe /transfer' to download a file from GitHub into the user's folder (Atomic Red Team T1197).

techniques.T1197: BITS Jobs - bitsadmin.exe creates a BITS transfer job
techniques.T1105: Ingress Tool Transfer - a file is downloaded from the internet onto the host

service_mod_fax.json.attack_summary: 'sc config Fax binPath=' points the Fax service at powershell.exe, 'sc start Fax' runs it as SYSTEM, then the binPath is restored (Atomic Red Team T1543.003).

techniques.T1543.003: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service - Fax service binPath is changed
techniques.T1059.001: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell - powershell.exe is launched by services.exe

mshta_javascript.json.attack_summary: cmd.exe runs mshta.exe with a javascript: one-liner that loads a remote .sct scriptlet from GitHub via GetObject, which launches calc.exe (Atomic Red Team T1218.005). Held-out test: no rules tuned on this log.

techniques.T1218.005: System Binary Proxy Execution: Mshta - mshta.exe executes attacker-supplied JavaScript
techniques.T1059.007: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript - JavaScript code is run via the javascript: protocol
